name: @coss-sv/typescript-config
description: Strict TypeScript configurations for COSS for Svelte workspaces

scripts.test: pnpm test:base && pnpm test:svelte-library && pnpm test:sveltekit
scripts.test:sveltekit: pnpm --dir tests/sveltekit exec svelte-kit sync && node tests/sveltekit/assert-config.mjs && svelte-check --tsconfig tests/sveltekit/tsconfig.json
